title: Uniform Node Work Bound
statement: For all natural numbers $n,k,b$, the maximum, over all subsets $P\subseteq[n]$, of the node work bound at failure parameter $\delta_{k,b}$ is at most $W_k(n+1)^{\lfloor3k/4\rfloor+4}(b+1)$. Here $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, $c_k=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $d_k=k-c_k$, $L_k=\lceil\log_2T_k\rceil+2(c_k+1)+5$, $\delta_{k,b}=T_k^{-1}2^{-(b+1)}$, and $W_k=2A_k+B_k+C_k$, with $A_k=2^{k+1}R_k+16\cdot4^kL_k$, $R_k=(c_k+1)(36\cdot4^kL_k)+2^{d_k}(d_k+1+L_k)$, $B_k=(c_k+1)(36\cdot4^kL_k)(c_k+1)+Q_k+(c_k+1)+(d_k+1)$, and $C_k=Q_k(d_k+2)+(d_k+1)Q_k(d_k+3)+(d_k+1)(d_k+2)$, where $Q_k=2^{d_k}(d_k+1+L_k)$.
hypotheses_covered: the bound is uniform over all subsets $P\subseteq[n]$
the failure parameter is the specified dyadic per-call failure parameter
caveat: The supplied definitions use a polynomial learner work bound and node analysis quantities whose formulas depend on a dimension-indexed monomial count; the concise constants above suppress those definitions and therefore do not fully identify the stated right-hand coefficient.
